name: buzzer-smd
title: Magnetic buzzer, surface mount
summary: Surface-mount magnetic buzzer (CUI CMI-9653S class): a square black LCP case with the orientation corner bevelled, the sound port in the top and two gold terminals at ±x, each a plate up the case end and a foot under it (body_length, body_width, height, corner_bevel, port_diameter, terminal_width, terminal_rise, terminal_out, terminal_depth).
provenance: Original work, authored through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` (`author_parts/families.rs`); dimensions from CUI Devices' public CMI-9653S-SMT-TR datasheet (12/15/2022, p. 2, mechanical drawing; https://www.cuidevices.com, downloaded 18 November 2026): case 9.6 × 9.6 × 5.0 mm, terminals 1.5 mm wide rising 2.4 mm, 0.25 mm proud of the case, at most 0.1 mm under it; the bevel, port, edge round and foot length estimated. No CAD or EDA library data was copied; product photographs were only looked at for comparison.
